parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host. 
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: ReviewRuleIds
parameters.description:
The array of audit policy IDs to delete.
> You can invoke the ListReviewRules operation to query this parameter.
